title: Penalty for Arriving Late to the Tee
question: If you arrive at the tee 3 minutes after your starting time, what is the penalty?

choices.text: You may play but receive a two-stroke penalty
You can play with no penalty

explanation: If you arrive within five minutes after your starting time, you may play but must add two penalty strokes. Arriving later than five minutes results in disqualification.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl hurries towards the teeing ground where a clock shows she is a few minutes late. Another group of players waits by the tee marker, some looking at their watches.
imageAlt: Teen girl arriving late at the tee with a clock visible and other golfers waiting.

issues: The waiting group is present but not all are explicitly looking at their watches, though one has arms crossed and another golfer has a club, which could slightly reduce thematic clarity about the lateness.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure at least one person in the waiting group is clearly checking their watch, visibly reacting to the player's lateness.
